background_interrupt.detail: Interruption: interruptService tested. Resource cleanup: turnLock.finishChatTurn identity-guard. Cleanup on interrupt: session finalised on close.

agent_context.detail: Fresh vs captured context: job spec frozen at creation. Provider/model/permissions captured at creation time. Config changes don't propagate (J12-H2). switch_model ignores background jobs (J12-H4).

mcp_tools.detail: Permission snapshot: frozen in job spec. Noninteractive confirmation: no user-in-the-loop for background jobs. Interrupt-only path (user can interrupt but cannot confirm).

provider_cloud.detail: Budget: roundtableBudget.js referenced. Retry: single-flight in scheduler. Provider availability: frozen in spec. No live re-evaluation on provider change (J12-H4).

db_artifacts.detail: Run persistence: agent_jobs + agent_runs cross-backend contract tests (J6-H4). Idempotency: scheduler single-flight prevents duplicate runs.

background_interrupt.detail: Queue → run → interrupt → restart/resume: full lifecycle tested E2E (J6-H1,3). No crash recovery (J6-H5 — no restart-resume mechanism). Budget exhaustion untested (J6-H2).

agent_context.detail: Session and cached-context invalidation: session finalised on close. Graceful shutdown drains in-flight work. No crash-recovery for in-flight background jobs (J6-H5).

mcp_tools.detail: In-flight tool disposition: MCP server process exits on shutdown — tools cannot be called after close. Background tool results: persisted in agent_runs.

provider_cloud.detail: Abort: provider abort signal fires on shutdown. Remote stream closure: AbortController.disconnect pattern tested in provider loops.

db_artifacts.detail: Flush/rollback: gracefulShutdown calls store.close(). Retention: pruners run on daily timer, not shutdown. Background worker cleanup: dedup/infer/pruner shutdown in gracefulShutdown.

background_interrupt.detail: Job terminal state: in-flight jobs lost on crash — no recovery mechanism. Safe rescheduling: jobs persist in DB, will re-queue on next boot if still enabled.
